direction_notes: LIPUS reduced colonic and hippocampal proinflammatory cytokines and improved behavioural deficits in DSS-treated mice; neural excitability was not assessed.

flags.reason: Paper gives 'spatial average intensity' without saying where it applies or whether it is temporal peak or average; recorded as unspecified-domain Isppa for lack of a better field.
Pulse duration not stated; not computed from duty cycle and PRF.
Group size n = 8 stated per group in Fig 2 legend (n varies 5-8 between panels); total not stated. Recorded for the two LIPUS groups only.
Abstract says LIPUS for 3 days, Fig 2 and Methods say Days 4 to 7; left not_reported.
Sham group appears to be a no-DSS group; DSS-only group is the untreated colitis comparison; no description of a sham sonication.
Plane transducer applied transcranially; focal target not defined; hippocampus was sampled for readouts only.
